title: The Cracked Saucer under the Napkin
youtube_title: The Cracked Saucer under the Napkin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Dahlia is tangled up with a saucer with a hairline crack hidden under a napkin and almost hides it. Dahlia tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
